# Swiss Ephemeris Java source

`swisseph-2.00.00-java-src-01.zip` is the unmodified source archive published
by Thomas Mack for the ready-to-use `swisseph-2.00.00-01.jar` bundled in this
repository.

The ZIP contains the original `README`, `LICENSE`, `Precompile.java`, Java
sources, test programs, and supporting files. Follow its original `README` to
generate normal Java sources before compiling.
